topic: AZ31 镁合金在铝酸盐–钨酸盐电解液中的微弧氧化：脉冲频率和单双极模式

tables.label: Table 1
tables.caption: Table 1. Composition of the bipolar coatings formed for 480 s in aluminate-tungstate electrolyte at different frequencies. The EDS results were obtained from a large area on the coating surface.

tables.label: Table 2

figures.label: Fig. 1
figures.caption: Figure 1. Cell potential-time responses (absolute values are given to the negative potential) for the PEO of AZ31 magnesium alloy in aluminate-tungstate electrolyte at different frequencies with/without negative pulse (a) bipolar regime; (b) unipolar regime.

figures.label: Fig. 2
figures.caption: Figure 2. Current waveforms recorded for the PEO of AZ31 magnesium alloy in aluminate-tungstate electrolyte under bipolar regime at different frequencies: (a) 100 Hz; (b) 1000 Hz; (c) 2000 Hz.

figures.label: Fig. 3
figures.caption: Figure 3. Real-time images of discharging sparks recorded at different stages of PEO of AZ31 magnesium alloy under different frequencies: (a) 100 Hz; (b) 2000 Hz. The exposure time of the camera is 0.125 ms and the area depicted is 10 mm×20 mm.

figures.label: Fig. 4
figures.caption: Figure 4. Sequential real-time images recorded during the PEO of AZ31 magnesium alloy under different frequencies between 300 and 302 s: (a) 100 Hz; (b) 2000 Hz. The exposure time of the camera is 0.125 ms and the area depicted is 10 mm×20 mm.

figures.label: Fig. 5
figures.caption: Figure 5. The effect of frequency on the thickness, surface roughness (Rₐ, R𝓏) of the coatings formed for 480 s in aluminate-tungstate electrolyte under bipolar regime.

figures.label: Fig. 6
figures.caption: Figure 6. Images for the appearance of coatings formed at 100, 1000 and 2000 Hz respectively under bipolar regime (a-c) and unipolar regime (d-f).

figures.label: Fig. 7
figures.caption: Figure 7. The plots of a*, b* and L* values (a-c) in the CIE L*a*b* color coordinate for PEO coatings formed for 480 s under different frequencies with/without the negative pulse. The a* and b* values indicate the location of color in the red-green and yellow-blue color coordinates, respectively. The L* value indicates the lightness of color. The color difference △E*(d) is the color difference between the PEO coatings and the white reference board.

figures.label: Fig. 8
figures.caption: Figure 8. The volume of gas evolution as a function of treatment time during PEO of the alloy under bipolar regime at different frequencies.

figures.label: Fig. 9
figures.caption: Figure 9. The SEM micrographs of surface and cross section of coatings formed for 180 s in aluminate-tungstate electrolyte by bipolar regime at 100 Hz (a-c) and 2000 Hz (d-f).

figures.label: Fig. 10
figures.caption: Figure 10. The SEM micrographs of surface and cross section of coatings formed after 480 s PEO treatment of AZ31 magnesium alloy in aluminate-tungstate electrolyte by bipolar regime at 100 Hz (a, b), 1000 Hz (c, d) and 2000 Hz (e, f).

figures.label: Fig. 11
figures.caption: Figure 11. The SEM micrographs of surface and cross section of coatings formed after 480 s PEO treatment of AZ31 magnesium alloy in aluminate-tungstate electrolyte by unipolar regime at 100 Hz (a, b) and 2000 Hz (c, d).

figures.label: Fig. 12
figures.caption: Figure 12. Schematic illustration of the coating formation processes at low frequency (a, b) and high frequency (c, d).

fields.label: 基体牌号
fields.description: The rolled magnesium alloy actually used as the substrate in this study. Copy the grade alone.
fields.pattern: A rolled (?P<value>AZ\d+[A-Z]?) magnesium alloy with a thickness of [\d.]+ mm was used as the substrate of PEO treatment

fields.label: 脉冲频率
fields.description: Actual PEO pulse frequencies in Hz introduced by the Experimental section. Leave the list as reported if the source gives a list.
fields.pattern: Coatings were fabricated at frequencies of (?P<value>\d+(?:, \d+)* and \d+) (?P<unit>Hz)

fields.label: 占空比
fields.description: Duty cycle used during constant-current PEO. Return its value and percent sign separately.

fields.label: PEO 处理时间
fields.description: Duration explicitly used to form the coating being measured or imaged. Exclude elapsed time on potential or gas curves, camera exposure, and pulse-cycle duration.
aliases: formed under the bipolar regime for
micrographs of coatings formed under unipolar regime for
fields.pattern: (?:formed under the bipolar regime for|the coatings are formed for|bipolar for|micrographs of coatings formed under unipolar regime for) (?P<value>\d+) (?P<unit>seconds|s)\b

fields.label: 波形电流密度
fields.description: Oscilloscope-reported spike or plateau in the current waveform. Include whether it is a spike or plateau and the frequency if verbatim in the quote. Only report area-normalized values.
aliases: the waveform features a high spike

fields.label: 末端正向槽电压
fields.description: Bipolar final positive cell potential at 480 s. Exclude the initial surge and negative potential; preserve approximate values.

fields.label: 实测涂层厚度
fields.description: Eddy-current measured coating thickness, including the reported ± term. Keep frequency and 480 s bipolar context when the quote supports them. Exclude substrate thickness and pore length.
aliases: coating thickness was determined by eddy
fields.pattern: (?=[^;]{0,140}?\b(?P<sample>\d+ Hz))(?:coating fabricated at \d+ Hz is the thickest, reaching up to an average value of|Coating thickness decreased along with decrement of frequency, being) (?P<value>\d+(?:\.\d+)?\s*±\s*\d+(?:\.\d+)?) (?P<unit>[μµ]m)(?: at \d+ Hz)?

fields.label: 色度 a*
fields.description: Measured CIE a* values for actual bipolar coatings. Preserve signed values and reported ± terms. Exclude the whiteboard reading.
fields.pattern: values of a\*, being (?P<value>[~≈]?\s*[-−+]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?(?:\s*±\s*\d+(?:\.\d+)?)?,\s*[~≈]?\s*[-−+]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?(?:\s*±\s*\d+(?:\.\d+)?)?\s+and\s+[~≈]?\s*[-−+]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?(?:\s*±\s*\d+(?:\.\d+)?)?) for samples fabricated by (?P<conditions>bipolar regime) at (?P<sample>\d+, \d+ and \d+ Hz) respectively

fields.label: 明度 L*
fields.description: Measured CIE L* of the actual coatings only. Keep the printed ± term. Exclude the whiteboard reference and other color coordinates.
fields.pattern: values of L\*, being (?P<value>[~≈]?\s*[-−+]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?(?:\s*±\s*\d+(?:\.\d+)?)?,\s*[~≈]?\s*[-−+]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?(?:\s*±\s*\d+(?:\.\d+)?)?\s+and\s+[~≈]?\s*[-−+]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?(?:\s*±\s*\d+(?:\.\d+)?)?) for three samples obtained at (?P<conditions>bipolar regime) respectively

fields.label: 色差 ΔE*
fields.description: Numerical CIE color difference between treated coatings and the whiteboard. Exclude L*, a*, b* values and qualitative claims.
fields.pattern: values of △E\* increased with increment of frequency, being (?P<value>[~≈]?\s*[-−+]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?(?:\s*±\s*\d+(?:\.\d+)?)?,\s*[~≈]?\s*[-−+]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?(?:\s*±\s*\d+(?:\.\d+)?)?\s+and\s+[~≈]?\s*[-−+]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?(?:\s*±\s*\d+(?:\.\d+)?)?) for three frequencies (?P<conditions>with negative pulse) respectively

fields.label: 析出气体体积
fields.description: Numerical bipolar gas volume after 480 seconds, retaining the measured ± term. The paper reports the three frequencies in ascending order.
aliases: volume of gas evolved at higher frequency

fields.label: 涂层 W/Al 原子比
fields.description: Atomic W/Al ratio of the coating. In the W/Al table column report only the value in parentheses (atomic ratio), never the value before parentheses (mass ratio) or elemental at%. In prose report only the explicitly named atomic ratio.
aliases: atomic ratio of W to Al
